newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello to hold briefing on retail data, Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Costello to hold briefing on retail data, Moody's.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello will hold a 0445 GMT (2.45 p.m.) briefing in Sydney on the May retail trade data and the announcement from ratings agency Moody's Investors Service, his office said on Wednesday.

Adjusted retail trade for May rose by 2.9 percent, which compared with analysts forecasts of a 2.0 percent rise. But they said the increase merely offset declines in the previous two months rather than signalling a rebound in consumer confidence.
Moody's, which has Australia's long term credit rating at AA2, said the nation's rating outlook had improved and cited solid fiscal and prudent monetary policies.
